name: Hako Capsule
description: Hako Capsule — a block theme for a station-front capsule hotel that sells a clean pod and a hot shower. A white page ruled in one-pixel ink lines, a thin tracked wordmark over a framed sticky nav, an ink slab hanging from the header with the single Book tonight link, and a full-bleed stage photograph of the night clerk handing a locker key across the counter, with a speech-bubble Tonight card docked at its lower right. The home page continues with a narrow three-paragraph column, a five-cell pod-bay wall, a comparison table of pods, cabin and day use, a parallax shower band, three notched numeral cards, ruled house rules, night-desk stories, a newsletter slot and an ink booking band. Geist for headings, Inter Tight for reading. Sample content in English. Quiet silver-grey palette; one amber dot is the only accent.

fonts.role: display: wordmark, headings, numerals (variable 300 to 600, Latin subset)
text: body copy, navigation, tables, labels, buttons and forms (variable, Latin subset)

summary.en: A station-front capsule hotel set in one-pixel ink rules: a hanging booking slab, a stage photograph with a Tonight card, a five-cell pod wall, a comparison table and notched numeral cards.
